dimensions.assessment: Affects traveling active-duty military personnel, accompanying family members, and airport screening operations at selected facilities.
dimensions.evidence: traveling active-duty military personnel and accompanying family members to support and facilitate the ease of travel

dimensions.assessment: Provides convenience through expedited screening options without altering core security vetting standards.
dimensions.evidence: Ensure each passenger described in such subsection is screened in accordance with the vetting status

dimensions.assessment: No specific appropriations or federal spending increases are stated in the text.
Permits a focused pilot program within existing TSA authorities, subject to specific operational boundaries.
dimensions.evidence: Administrator may establish a pilot program at airports to expedite access to security screening

dimensions.assessment: Carried out as a pilot program for a fixed duration of three years if established.
dimensions.evidence: Administrator shall carry out such pilot program for a period of three years

missing_information: The source does not state whether the pilot program will definitely be established or which specific airports will be selected.
importance_detail.rationale: Authorizes the TSA to establish a discretionary three-year pilot program for expedited security screening for active-duty military personnel and accompanying families at selected airports.
